title: perf(canary): adaptive auto-detection + hysteresis rollout guards for perf canaries
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Our existing performance canary detector uses fixed thresholds to detect latency/throughput regressions during rollouts. Fixed thresholds cause two operational problems: 1) noisy signals and flapping for workloads with bursty traffic and 2) missed regressions for profiles with naturally higher variance (long-tail seq lengths). This PR implements an adaptive detection algorithm with hysteresis and workload-aware thresholds, integrates KV-cache-aware checks, and wires the detector into rollout guards so canary traffic shifting will pause/fail fast on real regressions while avoiding false positives.
changes_summary:
- Add adaptive detector (EWMA + variance) with per-route sensitivity profiles.
- Introduce hysteresis windows to avoid rapid flip-flops when metrics hover near thresholds.
- KV-cache and batch-size aware adjustments so canaries on cached hot-prefixes don't mask regressions.
- New rollout guard that queries the detector and can pause/rollback canary traffic automatically.
- Unit + integration tests for synthetic workloads and a perf canary e2e test using the perf-canary harness.
- Docs updates: perf canary operational guide and console UI text.
- Metrics & tracing: new span + Prometheus metrics for detector decisions and hysteresis state.
commits: Initial adaptive-detector implementation (core algorithm and config)
Hysteresis state machine and pause/continue API for rollout controller
Tests: unit + integration + e2e perf-canary harness updates
Docs: add perf canary operational guide and console copy
Fix: address reviewer comments re: time-window edge cases
review_comments: Arjun: Please add an explanation for why EWMA was chosen over median-based detectors. Also include a brief note on expected false positive rate with default sensitivity.
Samira: Hysteresis looks reasonable, but the default retention window is 30s — this might be too short for heavy tail workloads. Can we parameterize and document?
Ethan: In integration runs we saw a spurious pause with bursty test traffic; please add KV-aware adjustment so cached prefixes don't trigger regression signals.
Maya (author): Addressed: added doc section, parameterized hysteresis window per profile, and KV-cache awareness using recent cache-hit-rate metric. Added test that simulates cached hot prefix.
Arjun: Thanks — added one nit on docs language, approved after CI green.
ci_history: First run: integration flaky causing a single test failure (e2e harness timeout) — increased timeout and re-run. Second run: all checks passed.
performance_benchmarks: With adaptive-detector (canary synthetic): detector decision latency < 10ms; false-positive rate < 0.5% in bursty workload test
Canary e2e: detector correctly paused rollout on injected +15% p95 regression in 2/3 runs and continued when rollback removed regression
testing_notes: Added unit tests for EWMA update logic, hysteresis transitions, and KV-aware adjustments. Integration test runs added to perf-canary harness simulate (a) steady traffic, (b) bursty traffic with high variance, (c) cached-hot-prefixes. e2e test uses docker-compose perf workload and validates rollout guard pause/continue paths.
deploy_notes: Feature is behind a feature-flag (perf_canary.adaptive_detection). Default profile uses conservative sensitivity. Rolling rollout: the rollout controller queries detector via internal API and will pause on DETECTED state. Ops: enable feature-flag in staging and run 24h canary before enabling in prod.
observability: New metrics: perf_canary_detector_decisions{route,decision}, perf_canary_hysteresis_state{route,state}, perf_canary_detector_latency_ms. Added tracing spans: perf_canary.detector.evaluate and perf_canary.rollout.guard_check. Dashboards updated: perf-canary -> Adaptive Detector panel.
docs: Added docs/perf-canary-operation.md with rationale, config knobs, tuning guide, and troubleshooting steps. Console copy updated to show detector sensitivity and hysteresis window per route.
release_notes: Introduce adaptive performance canary detector with hysteresis and KV-cache-aware thresholds. Provides more robust automated rollout guards to reduce false positives and improve regression detection sensitivity. (opt-in via feature flag).
